otid.title: Otid
otid.description: The offline threading id (OTID). Set by the client to deduplicate requests. Used for idempotency in background streaming mode — each message in a request must have a unique OTID. Retries of the same request should reuse the same OTIDs.

group_id.title: Group Id
group_id.description: The multi-agent group that the message was sent in

tool_returns.title: Tool Returns
tool_returns.description: List of tool returns from client-side execution

description:
Submit tool return(s) from client-side tool execution.

This is the preferred way to send tool results back to the agent after
client-side tool execution. It is equivalent to sending an ApprovalCreate
with tool return approvals, but provides a cleaner API for the common case.
